newsitem.title: USA: Comdisco to set up national dealer network.
newsitem.headline: Comdisco to set up national dealer network.

text.p: Comdisco Inc said Wednesday it will establish a national dealer organization to sell medical imaging and laboratory equipment reconditioned by its Comdisco Medical Exchange subsidiary.
Comdisco said the network will be made up of 20 local and regional sales/service providers, with the bulk of the network in place by this spring.
The company said reconditioned equipment can often be purchased for between 30 and 60 percent less than the cost of new medical devices.
Comdisco shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 31-3/4.
